claims.text: The resort is in Rancho Mirage and sits on 240 acres in the heart of the Coachella Valley near Palm Springs, California.

findings.quote: Omni Rancho Las Palmas Resort & Spa is located in Rancho Mirage and sits on 240 lush acres in the heart of the Coachella Valley near Palm Springs, California.

claims.text: The resort is set amid a mountainous backdrop surrounded by palms.

findings.quote: Set amid a mountainous backdrop surrounded by palms, Omni Rancho Las Palmas Resort & Spa is an idyllic resort

claims.text: Splashtopia, the resort's water park, offers two acres of family-friendly water activities including slides, a lazy river and a splashpad.

findings.quote: Splashtopia offers two acres of family friendly water activities including slides, a lazy river and splashpad.

### Stay Cool At Splashtopia

Our family-friendly water park

claims.text: The resort has 27 holes of golf made up of three nine-hole courses.
The resort has a full-service spa.
Plaza rooms are steps away from the spa.

findings.quote: Plaza rooms are the perfect destination for a romantic getaway. Spend some time relaxing at the spa just steps away from your accommodations

claims.text: Suites have dedicated living spaces and connecting room options.

findings.quote: Our expansive suites are the perfect place to entertain with dedicated living spaces and connecting room options.

claims.text: The resort has tennis and pickleball courts.
The resort has a fully equipped fitness center.
There are six dining outlets: three full-service restaurants, two pool bars and a cafe.

findings.quote: Six dining outlets - three full-service restaurants, two pool bars and a café

claims.text: Palm Springs International Airport is approximately 10 miles away.

findings.quote: Palm Springs International Airport (PSP) is approximately 10 miles (23 minutes) away.

claims.text: The Splashtopia water park has a cliff-side hot tub, a sandy beach, a lazy river and water-play zones with fountains and sprinklers.

findings.quote: Our family-friendly water park features a cliff-side hot tub, sandy beach, lazy river and unique water-play zones with fountains and sprinklers.

claims.text: The golf has views of the San Bernardino and San Jacinto mountains and is played on three rotations: North, South and West.

findings.quote: Enjoy championship golf with views of San Bernadino and San Jacinto mountains on three distinct rotations - North, South and West.

claims.text: Guest rooms and suites are inspired by Spanish Colonial design, with French doors that open out to patios or balconies.

findings.quote: Guest rooms and suites at our Palm Springs resort are bright and welcoming, thoughtfully inspired by Spanish Colonial design with French doors that open out to patios or balconies.

claims.text: Lakeview rooms have a furnished patio or balcony overlooking the water on the golf course.

findings.quote: the Lakeview rooms come with a furnished patio or balcony overlooking the water on the golf course.

claims.text: Self-parking and valet parking both carry a nightly charge.

findings.quote: Self-parking and valet parking with a nightly charge

claims.text: Pets are welcome only in specific buildings, must be under 50 pounds, and there is a per-pet charge for each stay.

findings.quote: Yes, Omni Rancho Las Palmas Resort & Spa is pet friendly in specific buildings. Pets must be less than 50 pounds and a $150 charge per pet, per stay will be applied.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes it is a large property, so reaching some amenities takes a walk.
